basic_details.job_title: BECIL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Senior Project Manager, Recruitment Executive Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Project Manager (Recruitment), Senior Project Manager (Payroll), Recruitment Executive
basic_details.short_information: Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL), New Delhi, Delhi, has invited applications for 4 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 567. The posts include Senior Project Manager (Recruitment), Senior Project Manager (Payroll), Recruitment Executive. Applications are accepted online until 5 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment through the application portal.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below
age_limit.details: Age is counted as on March 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Senior Project Manager (Recruitment): MBA (HR)/PG Degree or PG Diploma in HRM/Personnel Management or equivalent, 8 years' experience; Senior Project Manager (Payroll): MBA (Finance/HR)/M.Com or equivalent, 8 years' experience; Recruitment Executive: Graduate in any field, 2 years' experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: MBA (HR)/PG Degree or PG Diploma in Human Resource Management/Personnel Management or equivalent from a recognized University/Institution; minimum 8 years' experience in recruitment, HR operations or manpower outsourcing, including at least 3 years in a supervisory/managerial role. Experience required: Minimum 8 years' experience in recruitment, HR operations or manpower outsourcing, including at least 3 years in a supervisory/managerial role. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: 65,000. Qualification required: MBA (Finance/HR)/M.Com or equivalent qualification; minimum 8 years' experience in payroll administration with at least 3 years in a managerial role. Experience required: Minimum 8 years' experience in payroll administration with at least 3 years in a managerial

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated Rs. 65,000 per month (Senior Project Manager posts); Rs. 35,000 per month (Recruitment Executive)

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA admissible Canvassing leads to disqualification

how_to_apply: Visit https://becilregistration.in to complete the online registration process.
Fill the personal details in new registration and register.
Proceed to other details and payment to complete the application submission.
Pay the application processing fee: NIL for SC/ST, PWD; Rs.295/- for all other categories.
After successful online payment, save the application receipt.
Submit a separate application and fee for each post applied for.
important_instructions: Separate application and fee for each post applied for No modification or correction of the application after submission No TA/DA for attending any test, interview or document verification, or for joining Application processing fee is non-refundable and non-transferable Number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease Helpdesk: Phone 0120-4177850, E-mail [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply Candidates should be in sound health (both physically and mentally) Should not be accused in any pending inquiry and should be of impeccable integrity Police Verification Certificate to be submitted within a month of joining Preference to candidates who can join immediately Preference may be given to local candidates and/or those with relevant experience in same or similar department Desirable: Senior Project Manager (Recruitment): Experience in HRMS, Recruitment Management, Labour Laws, Project Management and Government manpower outsourcing projects Recruitment Executive: Experience in recruitment, HRMS, document verification and Government recruitment processes

content_sections.text: Qualification required: MBA (HR)/PG Degree or PG Diploma in Human Resource Management/Personnel Management or equivalent from a recognized University/Institution; minimum 8 years' experience in recruitment, HR operations or manpower outsourcing, including at least 3 years in a supervisory/managerial role. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract and full-time basis, initially for 1 year Period may be extended based on BECIL's requirement and satisfactory performance No right to claim regular appointment in BECIL Service may be terminated without prior notice if performance is not satisfactory No allowance such as DA, HRA, CGHS, transport or medical reimbursement is admissible Subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 during and after the assignment

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online payment through the application portal.

rows.event: Last date for online application (11:59 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will BECIL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications based on credentials and suitability, as per pre-approved criteria Interview in virtual or physical mode before the Screening-cum-Selection Committee Applications shortlisted for interview based on credentials and suitability, in accordance with pre-approved criteria Interview in virtual mode/physical mode as applicable; only shortlisted candidates will be informed Selection by the Screening-cum-Selection Committee constituted by BECIL Final selection depends on qualifications/experience, suitability for the post and performance in the interview

content_sections.heading: BECIL Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA admissible Canvassing leads to disqualification

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Requisite documents as specified against the eligibility/criteria of the post, with the online application Original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates and testimonials at document verification/interview Valid Police Verification Report (PVR) at the time of Document Verification after selection

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit https://becilregistration.in to complete the online registration process. Fill the personal details in new registration and register. Proceed to other details and payment to complete the application submission. Pay the application processing fee: NIL for SC/ST, PWD; Rs.295/- for all other categories. After successful online payment, save the application receipt. Submit a separate application and fee for each post applied for. Apply on or before 5 December 2026.

content_sections.text: Separate application and fee for each post applied for No modification or correction of the application after submission No TA/DA for attending any test, interview or document verification, or for joining Application processing fee is non-refundable and non-transferable Number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease Helpdesk: Phone 0120-4177850, E-mail [email protected]
